_comment: Product/sub-product filters that narrow the pull to credit card complaints only. CFPB renamed its product categories over time, so there are two: the retired 'Credit card' category (used before ~2018) and the current 'Credit card or prepaid card' category, which also covers non-credit products (prepaid, gift, payroll cards) that we exclude via sub_product. Verified against the live CFPB API on 2026-09-27.

sub_products: General-purpose credit card or charge card
